title: Compile exact bit circuits for synthetic twiddle headers
body:
## Summary

Compile the retained synthetic transform's actual relocated address bits into exact combined twiddle headers.

```text
physical MSB address bits
  mask each lower named bit by its axis branch bit
  sum modulo 2^(h+1) with AND/XOR ripple gates
  negate for the forward direction
  append ell-h zero bits to obtain E modulo 2r
```

PROOF.md proves the unbounded mixed long/short shape family. The opposite circuit has exactly `d_h*(6h+5)` gates, and forward negation adds `3*(h+1)`; zero/empty rounds use no gates. It also proves a sharp trailing-zero count, a scoped additive-affine obstruction, and an explicit fixed-tape scan algorithm costing `O(p^2 log(p+2))` per header under the source bounds. The executed implementation is a random-access bit-circuit interpreter; the tape scan is a written algorithmic proof.

Only `research/synthetic-twiddle-circuit/` changes. This addresses PR3516's supplied-exponent arithmetic gap. The source already states the exponent formula and polynomial-time production. Actual encoded descriptor parsing, executed tape lowering, packet/normalized-layer joins and the complete supplier/caller remain open. No source defect, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the signed polynomial data routine consumes supplied integer exponents, and the retained layout audit computes them with host integer arithmetic. **After:** explicit AND/XOR topologies agree with a separate integer oracle on 109,208 complete small address/round/direction cases and 250 wide cases through ell=256 and 64 axes. Four complete transform configurations check 184 ring-module/dense comparisons and 36,544 coefficients. Fourteen malformed inputs reject with valid retry.
- Registered CPython 3.12 and scoped Ruff pass. The real optimized CLI accepts its complete valid fixture and rejects six circuit faults plus changed receipt and changed/missing source. Final head `8ebe12b5d5ca542f1762b26f6f765c2789f3064d` passes committed-byte/source-history checks for all 14 source files and actual Git-free normal/optimized science and CLI controls. All 15 exported files retain bytes, modes and identities.
- Both runtime/proof inputs are canonical and authenticated. Pending PR3516/3504/3087 comparisons are separate from source ancestry. Fresh submission intake covers 435 open PRs and 2,364 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; arbitrary diffs and a full closed-PR scan are outside that coverage.

```sh
TMPDIR=/absolute/private/run python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/synthetic-twiddle-circuit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/synthetic-twiddle-circuit --check-source-history
```

Baseline/submission refresh is canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19010979). Credit Douglas Colkitt and the retained synthetic source, its Nussbaumer/Quandalle and Harvey/van der Hoeven lineage, Philipp/mightyOil's literal positional engine, and Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's related physical/phase work. No first encoded phase primitive is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected full cold replay were not run.

An isolated proof and opt-in replay package.

**Blast Radius:** Package
